name: Honeyed Allure
body:
Price 500 gp; Slot —; CL 5th; Weight —; Aura faint enchantment

DESCRIPTION

A creature handling or examining this object for 1 full round is captivated by it and consumed with a desire to wear or wield it (DC 14 Will negates). She always chooses to employ that item rather than another item that uses the same body slot. If it is a wielded item that does not require both hands to wield, she may use her other hand for anything she wishes and if wielding two weapons may choose which is her primary weapon.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 250 gp; Spells beguiling gift, bestow curse
